tei:div.tei:p: )bcom ldan gdugs dkar lha tshogs rnams// mthu stobs thogs pa mi mnga' zhing*// thugs rje smon lam mthu btsan pas// bdag gis ji ltar gsol ba bzhin// sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*// sems can bde dang ldan par mdzod// rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// chags che nyams nga bzlog tu gsol// rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa zlog /rtags dang rten 'brel ngan pa zlog /dgra 'dre'i bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog /ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa bzhi zlog /ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog /nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog// bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zlog /dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog /yas kyi bdud du g.yos pa zlog /mas kyi sri ru langs pa zlog /dpral ba'i gshed du bskos pa zlog// pha myes dur sri langs pa zlog /mi la nad du gtong ba zlog /phyug la god kha byed pa zlog /gnam gyi dal kha thebs pa zlog /sa yi dug mda' g.yos pa zlog /sme ba spar kha ngan pa zlog /skag dang phung sri langs pa zlog /mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog gyur cig /

ces pa 'di grub chen las kyi rdo rjes mdzad pa'o// ༈ bde gshegs thugs rje'i gtsug tor las 'khrungs shing*// bde 'byung bstan la gnod byed tshar bcad nas// bde legs 'bras bu nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// bde mchog gdugs dkar can gyi bkra shis shog //
